capabilities.reason: Organization and membership data are not fixed-project reads and membership actions are high-risk customer mutations.
Project reads are rooted in TERRASCALE_PROJECT_ID; creation, editing, placement, and deletion remain denied pending mutation admission.
Database metadata reads are scoped and projected; create, edit, branch, and delete operations remain denied pending mutation admission.
Environment metadata reads are scoped and projected; creation and deletion remain denied pending mutation admission.
Repository and schema responses are not currently part of the approved safe MCP projection.
Raw document content, document queries, and document mutations are outside the approved MCP read scope.
TQL and raw query inputs are prohibited; a bounded public query projection requires a separately reviewed contract.
Credential creation, rotation, and revocation are high-risk and secrets must never be returned or retained by MCP.
Only the globally public catalog is available; project placement changes require an admitted mutation contract.
Billing, checkout, portal, and payment operations require fresh authentication and a separately approved customer workflow.
Only fixed-project usage observations are exposed; no billing claims are inferred.
Only typed project observations are exposed; operator dashboards and private monitoring APIs are prohibited.
Inspection and the read-only external approval handoff are available. MCP cannot trigger backups or restore data.
Export responses may contain customer content and require a separately reviewed bounded delivery contract.

mutationAdmission.reason: The current MCP transports do not provide a genuine non-agent-controlled approval authority or an atomically consumed public token bound to these values.
